title: vm_host_* shouldn't erase all ansible connection values with defaults
author: collivier
body:
#6303 introduced new bugs as it sets use_own_value to all ansible connection variables.
see the following lines in ansible/group_vars/all/creds.yml and ansible/group_vars/vm_host/creds.yml
```
vm_host_user: use_own_value
vm_host_password: use_own_value
vm_host_become_password: use_own_value
```

and a related task in ansible/testbed_add_vm_topology.yml
```
  - set_fact: ansible_user="{{ vm_host_user }}"
    when: vm_host_user is defined
```

These variables should have been unset by default or at least compared to default in testbed_add_vm_topology.yml

Fixing this would make the KVM Testbed configuration very simple (docs/testbed/README.testbed.VsSetup.md) and less misleading. The configuration would just ask to set ansible_user for  STR-ACS-VSERV-01 (and even this could even been done automatically when setting the public keys).

linkedPullRequests.title: Stop overriding all ansible connection variables with 'use_own_value'
linkedPullRequests.author: collivier
linkedPullRequests.body:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/6303 asked to replace use_own_value to vm_host_xxx which override all ansible connection variables.
see the following lines in ansible/group_vars/all/creds.yml and ansible/group_vars/vm_host/creds.yml

vm_host_user: use_own_value
vm_host_password: use_own_value
vm_host_become_password: use_own_value

and a related task in ansible/testbed_add_vm_topology.yml

  - set_fact: ansible_user="{{ vm_host_user }}"
    when: vm_host_user is defined

These variables are now compared to default before changing all ansible connection values.
This could make the KVM Testbed configuration simpler (docs/testbed/README.testbed.VsSetup.md) as the configuration could now only ask to set ansible_user for STR-ACS-VSERV-01 (and even this could even been done automatically when setting the public keys).

Please note that this will defacto fix the documentation which forgets modifying vm_host_* vars in ansible/group_vars/all/creds.yml,

fix: #9790

comments.author: wangxin
comments.body: @collivier Can you elaborate why and how this change can help? If the `use_own_value` string is not updated to fit your environment, there would still be connection issue with this change.

comments.author: collivier
comments.body:
@wangxin once this patchset is merged we only have to change use_own_value for ansible_user in veos_vtb and that's it.

```
diff --git a/ansible/veos_vtb b/ansible/veos_vtb
index 632a195e9..7ed401218 100644
--- a/ansible/veos_vtb
+++ b/ansible/veos_vtb
@@ -271,7 +271,7 @@ vm_host_1:
   hosts:
     STR-ACS-VSERV-01:
       ansible_host: 172.17.0.1
-      ansible_user: use_own_value
+      ansible_user: cedric
       vm_host_user: use_own_value
 
 vms_1:
```

Please note that this will defacto fix the documentation which forgets modifying vm_host_* vars in ansible/group_vars/all/creds.yml, that it's safe for the gating workflows and that I will push a second PR about the documentation once this one is merged (Github can't manage the PR dependencies as Gerrit does).
